name: io.github.LocalProDev/local-services
title: LocalPro — Verified US Local Service Provider Data
description: Find a contractor or local business across 10 home-services trades — water-damage restoration, foundation repair, radon mitigation, mold/asbestos abatement, septic services, commercial electrical, basement waterproofing, crawl-space repair, floor coating, and laundry pickup. 7,000+ verified providers with customer ratings, opening hours, business status, and JSON-LD LocalBusiness output. No API key required.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Optional API key for premium fields (certifications, full pricing). All search and list tools work without a key.
